primary_statement.text: Exercise 6.74. Show that there exists a constant C_d > 0 such that if A is a subgraph of the box {0,...,n-1}^d and |A| < n^d/2, then |d_E A| >= C_d |A|^{(d-1)/d}. Here, d_E A refers to the edge boundary within the box, so this is not a special case of Theorem 6.22.
primary_statement.note: Printed once, in the collected in-text exercises of Chapter 6; the number 6.74 appears nowhere else in the 716-page fixed source, so there is no second body occurrence and no separate body theorem with the same target.

full_support_proof.route: Choose m maximising |P_m(A)| over the d coordinate projections; let F be the set of a in P_m(A) whose fibre P_m^{-1}(a) has full length n; observe that each a outside F contributes at least one edge of the edge boundary inside the box and that distinct a give disjoint edges, hence |d_E A| >= |P_m(A) setminus F|; then the Loomis-Whitney product |A|^{d-1} <= prod_j |P_j(A)| <= |P_m(A)|^d gives |P_m(A)| >= |A|/|A|^{1/d} >= 2^{1/d}|A|/n >= 2^{1/d}|F|; the last two steps are combined into |d_E A| >= |P_m(A) setminus F| >= (1-2^{-1/d})|P_m(A)| >= (1-2^{-1/d})|A|^{(d-1)/d}.
full_support_proof.completeness: The author prints the whole chain including the explicit constant (1-2^{-1/d}). Nothing in the argument is supplied by this reader; the only omissions recorded by the reviews are the mechanical absorption of small n into C_d and the choice of C_d, neither of which is added here.
